claim: Any two source-valid P/PN reference charts of the same regular chamber which share a PN face and all five geometric reference vertices admit a total PN-admissibility-domain transition preserving geometric face identity.
candidate_pair: Keep C0 and M1 fixed and swap the geometric vertices named M0 and C1. The selected PN face, C0 observation and all five reference vertices agree. The source face opposite old C1 is PN-eligible, but it becomes opposite target M0 and has only one target M.
lower_gates: Both P/PN charts and their selected transfers must validate through the actual source API. World-vertex identity permutations must satisfy pair/triple chart cocycles. These lower gates are expected to pass, so their failure would invalidate this discriminator.
domain_gate: A total map from source PN-eligible faces to target PN-eligible faces over geometric identity must send the lost face to itself, producing a false one-equals-two role count. Prove no such map exists. A partial identity on the shared domain remains possible and must not be conflated with total transport.
boundary: Refutes a fixed-geometry total standard-PN-domain adapter, not all chart transitions, all partial/role-indexed interpretations, the WG chart task package or the governing Ramsey conjecture.
stop_condition: Return the no-total-map witness after lower geometric/source checks, or the first failed lower gate. Do not promote permutation cocycles or shared-face readout to law-domain admission.
